WITH product1 AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv WHERE pv.brand = 'Gardena' AND pv.series = 'Gardena Smart PowerMax 280-5FI Manual Garden Tool' AND pv.model = 'Manual Garden Tool' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND ((property_key='tool type' AND property_value_text='pruning saw'))) = 1), product2 AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv WHERE pv.brand = 'Viega' AND pv.series = 'Viega Professional Sanpress 2OG-ENN Pipe Fitting' AND pv.model = 'Pipe Fitting' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND ((property_key='fitting type' AND property_value_text='pipe fitting') OR (property_key='diameter' AND property_value_text='15 mm') OR (property_key='connection type' AND property_value_text='threaded'))) = 3), product3 AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv WHERE pv.brand = 'Sika' AND pv.series = 'Sika Professional Sika 28T-UV8 Sealant' AND pv.model = 'Sealant' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND ((property_key='sealant type' AND property_value_text='hybrid sealant') OR (property_key='color family' AND property_value_text='Gray') OR (property_key='volume' AND property_value_text='280 ml'))) = 3), product4 AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv WHERE pv.brand = 'Portwest' AND pv.series = 'Portwest PW3 DX 3TU-ST2 Work Gloves' AND pv.model = 'Work Gloves' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND ((property_key='size' AND property_value_text='S'))) = 1), product5 AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv WHERE pv.brand = 'Ryobi' AND pv.series = 'Ryobi Precision RLM 2KQ-R4C Cordless Saw and Sander' AND pv.model = 'Cordless Saw and Sander' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND ((property_key='tool type' AND property_value_text='planer'))) = 1), product6 AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv WHERE pv.brand = 'Portwest' AND pv.series = 'Portwest PW3 DX 3TU-ST2 Work Gloves' AND pv.model = 'Work Gloves' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND ((property_key='size' AND property_value_text='M'))) = 1), all_products AS (SELECT product_sku, record_path FROM product1 UNION SELECT product_sku, record_path
